feature_profiles.name: Product Page Settings -- Cau hinh portal cho storefront rendering
feature_profiles.user_goal: La merchant (owner), cau hinh cach Teeinblue hien thi va van hanh tren trang san pham Shopify cua tung store (instance) da ket noi voi account -- gallery/mockup, personalization form, upload photo, cross-sell, nut Preview, nut ATC + addon charge, hanh vi mobile, cac tuy chon extras, logo, va style/mau sac -- rieng biet theo tung store, thong qua trang portal /product-page-settings (2 tab: Elements & Behaviors, Styles & Colors).

actors.role: owner (Linh explorer, user_id 266, staff record) -- portal
actors.permission_observed: Truy cap duoc toan bo route /product-page-settings, xem ca 2 tab, xem gia tri hien tai cua toan bo 67 control cho ca store1 va store2; nut Save/Reset hien dien + enabled nhung KHONG duoc click (forbidden_actions) nen CHUA xac nhan owner thuc su co quyen ghi hay chi co quyen doc. Chua co role/permission khac de so sanh (TIB_USER_A_*/TIB_USER_B_* khong co san run nay).

actors.role: [MỚI, CBS-009] merchant-owner (store owner/staff, portal staging, instance 520 Nprice1)
actors.permission_observed: Mở Store Settings → Product Page, đọc label setting lọc media theo variant (KB-318) và bật/tắt + Save setting này (KB-319, quan sát) trong lượt test 2026-10-22. Chưa thử role khác.

entry_points.path: Portal sidebar > Store Settings > Product Page Settings -> https://staging-portal.teeinblue.com/product-page-settings
entry_points.precondition: da login portal staging voi role owner, co it nhat 1 store/instance ket noi

entry_points.path: Sidebar '.user-switcher'/'.user-switcher-toggle' (avatar + ten account/store, top sidebar) -> panel 'Switch to:' -> chon store khac -> redirect ve '/' (Home) -> phai tu re-navigate thu cong ve /product-page-settings
entry_points.precondition: account co >=2 store ket noi (account nay co dung 2: linh-explorer.myshopify.com, linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com)

entry_points.path: Link '(Switch store?)' rieng, nam ngay tren chinh trang /product-page-settings (heading 'For store: <store> | <domain>') -- entry point THU HAI, DOM tach biet voi sidebar '.user-switcher', tu cap nhat dung theo store hien tai. Hanh vi click cua entry point nay CHUA duoc test rieng trong run nay (dung sidebar switcher thay the).

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Gallery & Mockup' (tab Elements & Behaviors)
capabilities.description: 7 control (checkbox 'Show Gallery & live preview', 'Load gallery immediately', 'Show only one Mockup image', 'Zoom gallery', 'Show navigation numbers on gallery', 'Show only the assigned images of the selected variant'; radio 'Display of Gallery's Thumbnails') hien thi dung gia tri hien tai, GIONG HET NHAU giua store1 va store2 trong sample nay. [CBS-009] Chuỗi label của checkbox lọc media theo variant đang CONFLICT chưa phân xử (CONF-sdk-assigned-media-setting-label, UNRESOLVED): KB-025 ghi 'Show only the assigned images of the selected variant' (quan sát 2026-09-21, store1/store2), KB-318 ghi 'Show only the assigned images and videos of the selected variant' và chuỗi cũ không còn (Testlane TC-TIB-6423 PASS 2026-10-22, instance 520). Chờ PO quyết; không dùng chuỗi nào làm oracle cho label. Các giá trị khác của KB-025 không bị conflict chạm.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Personalization Form' (tab Elements & Behaviors)
capabilities.description: 12 control (dropdown 'Form type', cac checkbox ve search/sync/auto-select/form header/date-time picker/text reposition/auto-zoom/clear-all) hien thi dung gia tri hien tai, GIONG HET NHAU giua 2 store. 2/3 gia tri cua dropdown 'Form type' (popup, expand/collapse) CHUA duoc thu de xem co he lo sub-field khac hay khong.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Upload Photo' (tab Elements & Behaviors)
capabilities.description: 4 control (re-upload button trong popup, photo reposition on mockup, cho phep chon lai anh da xu ly truoc do trong cua so 72h, auto-zoom) hien thi dung gia tri hien tai, GIONG HET NHAU giua 2 store.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Cross-sell Personalization' (tab Elements & Behaviors)
capabilities.description: 1 checkbox 'Show Cross-sell Personalization' (cho phep buyer ca nhan hoa + them 1 item phu cung san pham chinh) = unchecked mac dinh, giong nhau ca 2 store.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Preview button' (tab Elements & Behaviors)
capabilities.description: 4 control (show/hide nut Preview, radio anh hien trong popup, show close text, block preview neu field con trong) hien thi dung gia tri hien tai, GIONG HET NHAU giua 2 store.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'ATC button' + 'Addon Charge' (tab Elements & Behaviors) -- 1 control bi he thong khoa
capabilities.description: 'Show Confirmation checkbox' (ATC button) = unchecked ca 2 store. 'Show addon price warning message' (Addon Charge) = checked VA DISABLED (khong the toggle tu UI nay, help text 'Required to enable by Shopify. Contact support to change.') -- day la 1 control system-locked, khong phai bug UI; 'Show addon price on options' = unchecked ca 2 store.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Mobile' (tab Elements & Behaviors)
capabilities.description: 3 checkbox (nut Personalize tren mobile, mui ten navigation cua gallery tren mobile, thumbnail cua gallery tren mobile) = checked ca 3, giong nhau ca 2 store.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Extras' (tab Elements & Behaviors)
capabilities.description: 4 checkbox (collapse description block, skeleton loader, block inspecting clipart, load scripts ngoai trang san pham) = unchecked ca 4, giong nhau ca 2 store.

capabilities.name: Upload logo (tab Elements & Behaviors) -- CHUA test, khong co duong revert an toan xac dinh duoc
capabilities.description: Nut 'Upload logo' hien dien ca 2 store, khong thay logo thumbnail hien co. CHUA duoc click trong run nay vi khong xac nhan duoc duong revert don gian trong pham vi SAFE_REVERSIBLE_ONLY ma khong keo theo nguy co phai Save.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Theme' (tab Styles & Colors)
capabilities.description: Radio 'Choose a Theme:' (Classic/Modern/Dark) = 'Modern' ca 2 store. 'Font size:' gom 3 icon-only swatch, hien dien ca 2 store nhung lua chon dang chon KHONG doc duoc qua accessibility tree.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Personalization form' styling (tab Styles & Colors)
capabilities.description: 9 control (3 color-picker header/form-background, toggle-style icon-swatch, radio 'Thumbnails per row' = Auto, alignment icon-swatch, active-color color-picker, border-radius icon-swatch, addon-charge-warning color-picker) hien dien giong het nhau ve nhan/cau truc ca 2 store; gia tri hex va lua chon icon-swatch KHONG doc duoc.

capabilities.name: Xem cau hinh 'Colors' (tab Styles & Colors)
capabilities.description: 1 dong ghi chu ('Some options only work with Campaigns by Product base.') + 10 color-picker (Primary color, cac mau nut Preview/Personalize o trang thai thuong/hover, mau thong bao loi/invalid) hien dien giong het nhau ve nhan/cau truc ca 2 store; gia tri hex KHONG doc duoc.

QUAN TRONG: day CHI LA correlation theo ten/gia tri, KHONG PHAI mot data contract da xac nhan field-by-field qua code reference -- giu nguyen knowledge_kind INFERRED, KHONG duoc trinh bay nhu binding da confirm khi viet checklist/oracle. Chi co 1 sample day du (observed_count=1, confidence LOW cho ban than response body).

dependencies.description: Feature nay la nguon cau hinh candidate (INFERRED, chua field-by-field) cho hanh vi hien thi/van hanh cua FEAT-07-storefront-buyer-facing tren storefront -- qua binding APIOP-001 .config. KHONG duoc trinh bay nhu 1 data contract da xac nhan.

Phu thuoc vao code-config-explorer de resolve CFL-005 (config_registry schema ~38 key vs instance.config thuc te ~27 key, chi 1 ten trung) truoc khi bat ky field nao trong config_registry duoc coi la khop voi 1 control cu the tren trang nay ngoai '27 key thuc te quan sat duoc'.

Ca 2 field then chot cua CFL-004 (sdk_version va .config byte-identical giua 2 instance) den tu CUNG 1 API response (APIOP-001) ma feature nay dang mo ta -- vi vay resolution cua CFL-004 (thuoc profile FEAT-07) co the anh huong nguoc lai cach doc 'toan bo config giong het nhau giua 2 store' cua chinh feature nay (co phai vi 2 instance dang thuc su cung 1 trang thai, hay vi 1 trong 2 nguon da lac hau).
[MỚI, CBS-009] Setting lọc media theo variant (show_assigned_variant_images_only, quan sát) được storefront đọc qua merchant JSON; hiệu ứng lên gallery theo variant thuộc storefront-buyer-facing.

risks.description: [NOI BAT] CFL-004 UNRESOLVED -- 3 evidence sides (KB cu 2026-09-12: store1=v1/store2=v2, HIGH tai thoi diem ghi nhan; GET /api/instances?trashed CUA CHINH FEATURE NAY (2026-09-21): sdk_version=2 ca 2 instance, LOW/1 sample; storefront runtime re-check 2026-09-21: store1 hien serve app-v2.js/tee-campaign-v2, HIGH/2 pass doc lap, hoi tu voi evidence portal-side). Truc tiep implicate tinh current cua 5 capability da publish trong profile FEAT-07-storefront-buyer-facing (KB-004, KB-005/006, KB-007, KB-010, KB-011). KHONG resolve o day, KHONG chon 1 phia dung -- chi orchestrator + reviewer moi duoc quyet (contract sec.8). Feature nay la 1 trong 2 nguon evidence chinh cua conflict (cung voi storefront-explorer).

CFL-005 UNRESOLVED -- config_registry.instance.config (~38 key SCHEMA khai bao qua APIOP-002) vs instance.config THUC TE (~27 key qua APIOP-001), chi 1 ten trung ('add_design_links', va ban than 'add_design_links' cung CHUA duoc khop voi 1 control cu the nao trong 67 control quan sat duoc). Can code-config-explorer / backend source xac nhan: co phai APIOP-001 chi tra ve key da set (bo qua schema default chua set), hay 2 'instance.config' la 2 namespace khac nhau, hay schema dang stale/aspirational. KHONG tu resolve o day.

Binding APIOP-001 .config <-> 67 UI control la INFERRED (tuong quan ten/gia tri), KHONG PHAI contract da xac nhan qua code reference. qa-checklist-builder KHONG duoc viet oracle coi day la field-by-field data contract chac chan -- vi du 'thay doi checkbox X se ghi dung key Y trong .config' KHONG duoc khang dinh cho toi khi co code reference hoac response cua write-path (Save) duoc quan sat.

Write-path (Save/Reset) hoan toan chua co evidence -- Save/Reset chua tung duoc click trong bat ky run nao tinh toi nay (forbidden_actions). Moi test case gia dinh ve hanh vi luu/validate-khi-luu deu se la suy dien, khong co evidence. [CBS-009] Bổ sung: lượt test Testlane 2026-10-22 trên instance 520 đã Save riêng setting lọc media theo variant và quan sát PUT /api/instances/<id>/config với key show_assigned_variant_images_only (KB-319, OBSERVED_CURRENT/LOW, ngoài oracle); write-path của các control khác và Reset vẫn chưa có evidence.

Gia tri hex cua ~13 color-picker va lua chon cua cac icon-only swatch control (Font size, Toggle style, Alignment, Field's border radius) KHONG doc duoc qua accessibility tree trong run nay -- chi xac nhan duoc su hien dien/cau truc, khong xac nhan duoc gia tri dang chon. Anh huong truc tiep den kha nang viet oracle 'gia tri X phai la Y' cho cac field nay.

Chi 1 role (owner) duoc test -- bien thien permission/role tren trang nay hoan toan chua duoc quan sat. Khong co evidence cho case: role thap hon co thay duoc Save/Reset hay khong, co bi an bot control nao khong.

[MỚI, CBS-009] Conflict CONF-sdk-assigned-media-setting-label UNRESOLVED: checklist/oracle kiểm chuỗi label của setting lọc media theo variant theo bất kỳ phía nào (KB-025 hay KB-318) đều có thể kiểm sai cho tới khi PO quyết. Hai phía còn khác môi trường quan sát (store1/store2 2026-09-21 vs instance 520 2026-10-22) và KB-318 chạy trước khi 4 PR TIB-5428 merge (shipped UNKNOWN).
